outcomes.ADMISSIBLE_FOR_SEPARATE_TEST: A genuinely justified connection, with units, observable role, refinement meaning, scope, evidence and falsifier; not a restatement of the Markov definition.
outcomes.HOLD_FOR_EVIDENCE: One missing kinetic-clock identification law, its minimal evidence interface and reentry condition; no general no-go.
outcomes.NOT_ADMITTED: An explicit proposed shortcut fails the fixed-source/meaning contract; no rejection of all candidate models.

verification: Source/pointer/hash audit plus separate independent and hostile review. No new finite dynamics runs. Lean only if a new formal proposition is actually claimed.
non_claims: No model, functional, rate, nu, state, time, projection, algebra or comparison change.
No new carrier, counterterm, rate fit, observation fit, satellite search, external contact or repeated owner hunt.
No physical time, Pre-A, Sector-A, spacetime, QFT, gravity, horizon, continuum or TOE conclusion.
No automatic successor. Any new law stays an unadopted proposal requiring separate approval.
packaging: Definition/route audit only: strategy certificate, review receipt, reproducible provenance check and exploration/changelog. No new theorem/result ID or intermediate PDF. Existing fresh-PDF release gate remains required.
